plain_english: Truly, O Śaṅkara: vow, giving, bathing, austerity dispel becoming's heat. Rites relativized, not despised. Contemplation of Your scripture as supreme nectar streams a bliss-stream in mind.
sanskrit_cite: śaṅkara satyam idam vratadānasnānatapaḥ bhavatāpavidāri tāvakaśāstra parāmṛtacintā cetasi nirvṛtidhārām syandati
